coarray.assumptions: Assumptions: narrowband far-field sources, mutually UNCORRELATED and stationary over the T snapshots, equal power, SNR per source per sensor; sensors on a half-wavelength grid; white noise; number of sources known. 'ok' = every source matched to within half the source spacing.

freqdiv.assumptions: Assumptions: one source 0-15 deg above the horizon, azimuth-only Bartlett beamscan (assumes 0 deg); 3 deg / 0.5 dB calibration residual per whip, the SAME at every tone; 20 dB per-whip SNR and 64 samples in total, split evenly over J = 8 tones spread across the stated fractional bandwidth (an emitter that really occupies that band: a hopper, a wideband burst, or our own stepped radar/calibration signal); spectra added incoherently. Gross error = more than 10 deg.

rotation.assumptions: Assumptions: the sky does not change while the aperture is synthesised (minutes for the turntable, hours for Earth rotation); gains are calibrated across the whole synthesis; a planar array, so the response depends only on the horizontal direction cosines (l, m) and the point-spread function is shift-invariant; cross-correlations only, natural weighting. Sidelobes are relative to the peak (1 = as strong as the main lobe); they measure how well several sources can be told apart in one image.

mimo.assumptions: Assumptions: point targets in the far field, isotropic elements (so sidelobes at wide angles are pessimistic), perfectly orthogonal transmit waveforms unless 'TDM' is named, a target that does not move during the coherent interval unless a speed is named, calibration perfect. Patterns are two-way (transmit x receive) azimuth cuts of the panel at 5.8 GHz and of the whip plate at 915 MHz.

threshold.assumptions: Assumptions: two uncorrelated equal-power sources at the horizon, 915 MHz, the 16-whip two-ring layout, all 16 whips sampled together (256 samples), number of sources known; calibration residual per whip of 0 / 1 / 3 deg (with 0 / 0.17 / 0.5 dB). Resolved = MUSIC shows two peaks, each within half the separation of a source.

switched.assumptions: Assumptions: K uncorrelated equal-power sources at the horizon, at least 0.8 beamwidth apart (30 deg at 915 MHz, 12 deg at 2300 MHz), 10 dB per-whip SNR, 3 deg / 0.5 dB calibration residual, 4096 samples IN TOTAL however they are split into slots (so a 16-slot scheme has 256 per slot); the sources are stationary unless 'bursty': the observation is cut into 16 equal intervals and each source is on or off for a whole interval with probability 1/2 (on at least once); every scheme sees the same 16 intervals (one slot of the 16-slot scheme = one interval, one slot of the 4-slot scheme = four). A trial is a success when all K sources are found within a third of the minimum separation. The number of sources is given to the peak picker. Port-to-group assignment: whip index mod 4 (an assumption; REDESIGN.md section 4 lists the groups by port, not by position on the plate).

astro.assumptions: Assumptions (ESTIMATES, not measurements): one polarisation; a whip over the plate has 2 dBi towards a source 30-60 deg up; a panel element has the lattice-cell gain 4 pi (25 mm)^2 / lambda^2; system temperature = receiver (REDESIGN.md noise figures) + 150 K of ground and sky for a whip (it sees the ground as well as it sees the sky) or + 50 K for the panel pointed up; 20 MHz of bandwidth, except where the protected band is narrower; cross-correlations only, point sources, gains stable for the whole integration. Interferometer noise: dS = SEFD / sqrt(Npairs_simultaneous * 2 * B * t), SEFD = 2 k Tsys / Ae, Ae = G lambda^2 / 4 pi. 'switched' = 4 of the 16 elements at a time (6 of the 120 pairs), any schedule.
